senses.gloss:
ghṛta
------------------------------------------
Ghṛta (ghee, clarified butter) has been held in high esteem right from the Ṛgvedic times. Libation of घृत into a duly consecrated fire is a part of many a ritual in हिन्दुइस्म्. Lighting a lamp in front of a deity using घृत instead of oil has been considered as a meritorious act.
The Suśruta Saṁhitā attributes many medicinal qualities to ghee such as cures of diseases like insanity, epilepsy, colic and fever. ‘Kumbhaghṛta’, ghee matured in a pitcher for eleven to a hundred years, will become possessed of mystic potencies capable of warding off monsters!
Ghṛta, cooked a hundred times in succession with a quantity of vacā (an aromatic root) and taken every day extends one’s life to five centuries!
